title: Professor Jiang: Is World War 3 About To Begin?
summary: A history teacher argues the US war on Iran is a petrodollar war that will widen into a third world war, with a US draft, a NATO-Russia fight for Odessa and conflict in East Asia.

assertions.quote: I think we're already in the catalyst moment. I think we're we're already in World War III
This war, once it starts, can only to World War III.

verdicts.note: Forecasters put a great-power war over the next few years well below even odds, and Russia and China have backed Iran with words and supplies, not forces.
With the Iran war already under way, Metaculus forecasters still put a world war at only 22% before 2050, which rules out an almost-certain escalation into one.
The 2026 war ended in a Pakistan-brokered ceasefire after about forty days with no great-power fighting; Russia and China only vetoed a UN resolution.

assertions.quote: So the next step will be the Russians come into this war on the side of the Iranians.
My second prediction is there'll be a grand bargain between the United States and China.
He didn't expect that the Iranians would close off the Strait of Hormuz.
Iran is another forever war and the United States will institute a national draft.

verdicts.note: Automatic Selective Service registration is not a draft; induction needs a new act of Congress, and none has been proposed.

assertions.quote: I think there's a very strong possibility that the American empire will collapse in the next 5 to 10 years

verdicts.note: No base rate or model supports a dated collapse; the US remains the largest military and the issuer of the main reserve currency.
Only 10% of respondents outside the Global South (22% within it) expect the US to break up within ten years, and 60-76% expect it to keep military dominance.

assertions.quote: NATO and Russia will fight for Odessa.

verdicts.note: NATO governments have repeatedly ruled out sending combat forces to fight Russia in Ukraine, and forecasters put a direct NATO-Russia war well under even odds.
Metaculus forecasters give uniformed NATO troops in Ukraine by 2027 3.4%, and any direct Russia-NATO conflict before 2027 4.2%.

assertions.quote: this conflict it's going to expand outwards uh into a global conflict and there's nothing anyone can do to stop this

verdicts.note: The wars share some backers, such as Iranian drones and North Korean troops for Russia, but they are not one coordinated war, and China and Russia stayed out of the Iran war.
North Korean and Iranian military support to Russia links some conflicts, but US intelligence says adversary cooperation is limited and overstated, not a two-bloc global war.

PRIO sorts 2025's international conflicts into separate border conflicts, Middle East regional escalation and two invasions, and says that while they reflect rising tension, the conflicts are separate.
UCDP: the sharp rise in interstate conflict remains concentrated in relatively few countries (half in the Middle East, two involving Pakistan), which is not one war between two blocs.

assertions.quote: If it were not to invade Iran, it would lose its empire. Its empire is based purely on US dollar, the petrodollar

verdicts.note: The motive is not on the public record; the stated aims concerned Iran's nuclear programme and regime.
The paper gives the war's aims as subduing Iran or toppling its regime and does not mention the dollar.

assertions.quote: But East Asia breaks out into conflict.

verdicts.note: No forecast or official threat assessment puts a war over Taiwan, Korea or the South China Sea in the next few years at anything near even odds.

While the US is engaged with Iran, Polymarket priced a China-Taiwan military clash before 2027 at 3.8%, a Taiwan blockade in 2026 at 2.55% and a North Korean invasion of the South before 2027 at 5.5%.
